title: Assistant Director of Finance and Administration for Student Engagement
bio: I am responsible for the oversight of the Student Engagement departmental budget, student organization finances, managing and allocating the student activity fee, as well as serving as a resource to student organizations who seek advising on how to manage their student organization finances. I like to travel, bike with my husband and kids. I sing in the choir, and I enjoy doing yoga and Zumba. I have been at Harvard since September 2014, I previously worked at the Department of Chemistry and Chemical Biology within FAS as the Senior Sponsored Research Administrator . Bachelor of Arts from the College of Saint Benedict and a Master of Science in Project Management from Boston University. Area Student Engagement Role Central
